messages:
Anya (customer): Hey support — our tenant (org: acme-marketing) just had a failed manual user provisioning and now the audit export for last 24h is missing entries. We need this for a compliance review (SOC2). Any idea?
Sam (support): Sorry to hear that. Can you share the user_id and approx time? Also any error you saw in the UI or API? :eyes:
Anya (customer): user: user_1839, attempted at 2026-03-16T18:12:02Z. UI showed a generic "Provisioning error". We tried resync -> same. SCIM logs show a 500 from our side then a downstream KMS unwrap error in your logs.
Sam (support): OK grabbing logs now. @Lee can you help triage KMS/HSM side? If unwrap failed we need to understand whether the DEK was rotated or HSM access timed out.
Lee (security): I'm on it. Can you paste the Correlation-ID or request id from the UI? Also, is this the "manual provision" flow (customer-triggered) or an automated SCIM job?
Anya (customer): Manual via the console. Correlation-ID: c2f7b9b7-8f3a-4d1e-9b7e-3f12a9d5f0a1.
kms-bot: [automated] HSM_UNWRAP_ERROR request=c2f7b9b7-8f3a-4d1e-9b7e-3f12a9d5f0a1 code=0x31 node=gpu-rt-03 region=us-west-2
Jordan (eng): Thanks — that node shows a transient HSM RPC timeout around 18:12Z. Stack: 
```
2026-03-16T18:12:02Z ERROR kms/hsm client.go:142 unwrap: rpc timeout
2026-03-16T18:12:03Z WARN serving/runtime batch.go:438 revert to fallback key
```
Sam (support): So the provisioning failed because we couldn't unwrap the tenant key; fallback path should have allowed the operation to continue but it looks like the provisioning flow doesn't use fallback in manual console mode. That's a bug surface.
Lee (security): Two asks from security/compliance: 1) Customer needs the audit lines for that provisioning attempt (successful or failed) exported for evidence. 2) We need to know if any other tenants were affected by the HSM timeout window.
Sam (support): @Maya can you assist with retention/export permissions and whether we can generate an ad-hoc export for acme-marketing?
Maya (billing): I can trigger an audit export if security approves and the customer signs the non-disclosure addendum. ETA for pull/export: ~2 hours. I need tenant_id (t-acme-77) and time window.
Anya (customer): Tenant id t-acme-77, window 2026-03-16T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-17T00:00:00Z. We need both the SCIM provisioning logs and KMS event lines.
Lee (security): Approving export for compliance evidence. Sam: capture chain-of-custody notes. Also we need to confirm whether DEK rotation ran in that window — if rotation occurred and unwrap failed, we must log that as part of incident evidence.
Jordan (eng): Quick repro notes: can reproduce on staging by toggling HSM RPC to delay 2s+ then triggering manual provision via console. Repro steps: 1) set KMS_SIM_DELAY=2500 2) open console -> Users -> Provision manual -> submit. Logs above.
Sam (support): Thanks Jordan. Action plan: 1) Maya to run export for that tenant/time window (Maya) 2) Eng to scope and fix console fallback for manual provisioning (Jordan) 3) Security to verify DEK rotation state in window (Lee) 4) Share export output with customer and compliance (Sam).
ops-oncall: Flagging incident INC-2026-0316-KMS for tracking. Will add alert for HSM RPC timeouts on gpu-rt-0* nodes.
Anya (customer): Appreciate the quick triage. Please confirm when export is ready and whether the provisioning can be retried safely after you fix fallback.
Sam (support): Will update in thread. Maya — please DM me when export completes so I can attach to ticket. :thumbsup:
Maya (billing): Started export job EJ-9921, status: queued. I'll post the download link here when ready.
Lee (security): Also please redact any unrelated user PII before we hand to auditors; leave tenant and event metadata intact.
Jordan (eng): Working on a small server-side guard: if HSM unwrap fails during manual console flow, fall back to cached DEK or surface a clear retry button rather than generic error. Patch PR incoming.
Sam (support): Noted. I'll mark this high priority and keep customer posted.
Anya (customer): Thanks all. I'll pause further provisioning attempts until you confirm.
kms-bot: [automated] HSM_UNWRAP_RECOVERED request=c2f7b9b7-8f3a-4d1e-9b7e-3f12a9d5f0a1 node=gpu-rt-03 time_recovered=2026-03-16T18:15:07Z
Sam (support): Export job EJ-9921 completed. Link: https://s3.redwood-internal/exports/EJ-9921/acme-marketing-audit-20260316.zip (shared via secure channel). Sent to Anya via secure DM.
Anya (customer): Got it, thank you. Will review and get back if anything missing.
Sam (support): Closing loop: Jordan to ship console fallback patch today, Lee to confirm rotation status by EOD, Maya confirmed export delivered. Reopen if anything else. :white_check_mark:
